name: Control (droid)
description: Control was a Terreene Brainiac model of control droid tasked with running the Imperial mobile mining operation on the planet Alabash. It was well-programmed to carry out its task, finding and extracting ores from the surface of a planet. It was also capable of defending itself, but lacked the equipment to do so and instead deployed the various droids under its control to deal with threats.
